title: Mixing
author: 3sd26
rules:
Rules:

1) Normal sudoku rules apply.

2) All low digits (1,2,3,4) are orthogonally connected to form one big shape.

3) All odd digits (1,3,5,7,9) are orthogonally connected to form one big shape.

4) A black line connects 2 digits that sum to 10 (the x symbols are two lines)

5) On the '7', diagonally adjacent cells sum to 7.

6) Digits on a black dot are in a 1:2 ratio

Hint:

Starting this sudoku requires you to find the set from rule 2 first. There is only 1 way to have a set of 4 digits orthogonally connected over the whole grid (excluding it's symmetries). Finding this configuration is a whole puzzle on it's own. If you don't want to discover this shape on your own, you can solve my previous sudoku 'Haunted river', there I guide you to discovering the shape more easily.

Solve here: https://sudokupad.app/pvs7u7bz9m

Happy Solving!
solutionCode: The digits from the first column, top to bottom as one string.
